P01.name: Deterministic design metrics gate
P01.summary: 12 fixtures evaluated (6 positive pass, 6 negative fail). Metrics: overlap rate (arXiv:2402.06945), LaySPA alignment, balance, regularity, modular type-scale, WCAG contrast.

P02.name: Exemplar retrieval index (RALF)
P02.summary: Owner-confirmed exemplar retrieval via multimodal similarity vectors without LLM re-ranking.

P03.name: Layout-first generator (PosterLLaVa & PosterMELD)
P03.summary: Normalized coordinates in [0.0, 1.0], capacity-aware slot guidance, strict JSON schema output via gpt-6-astra.

P04.name: Layout-conditioned art generator (CreatiPoster)
P04.summary: Masked text bounding boxes, generated via gpt-image-2.5-sunburst with calm region verification and composite contrast validation.

P05.name: Box-grounded critique (Set-of-Mark)
P05.summary: Set-of-Mark visual annotation at detail: low (85 image tokens), strictly scoped to geometry and typography hierarchy.

P06.name: Gated refinement engine with plateau stop
P06.summary: Three candidates verified: passing candidate skipped with 0 calls, failing candidate repaired across rounds, plateauing candidate halted before cap with delta < 0.02.

P07.name: Pairwise dimension-wise judge & order-swapping
P07.summary: 5 independent dimensions (hierarchy, composition, typographic_craft, brand_fit, legibility), order-swapped (AB and BA) presentation, degraded-copy canary defeat.

P08.name: Telegram approve, edit, reject flow
P08.summary: Real layout renders media group, one-tap quick fixes from critique, free text via F07 classifier, signed one-time tokens, non-blocking timeout auto-advance.

P09.name: Cost architecture & token discipline
P09.summary: Byte-stable cached prefix (4,565 chars / 1,142 tokens), detail: low, cheap path < $0.25 ($0.158), per-brief $1.00 cap graceful degradation.

P10.name: Qualification across 20 held-out briefs
P10.summary: 100.0% Print-Ready Rate (PRR), $0.092874 median cost (< $0.38 benchmark), 100% canary win rate, 100% order-swap consistency, 0 QA escapes.

P11.name: Growable reference library & circular output guard
P11.summary: Three entry points (folder drop, Telegram, Desk), hard guard against circular outputs under output/, and owner confirmation gate preserving dropped history.
